texts: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Today we're zooming in on fruits and vegetables. Each photo starts super close, then slowly zooms out. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
Kick-off! Here's your first fruit or vegetable. Any idea?
Yes! It's a Strawberry. Its seeds are on the outside. About 200 of them on each berry.
Take a good look. Which fruit or vegetable is this?
That's a Banana. Bananas grow on giant plants that are not actually trees.
Easy one... or is it? Name this fruit or vegetable!
It's a Pineapple. A pineapple plant takes around two years to produce one fruit.
Eyes on the screen. What fruit or vegetable do we have here?
Correct answer: a Watermelon. Watermelon is about 92 percent water.
You've seen this one before. Which fruit or vegetable?
Of course, it's an Orange. Brazil is the world's biggest orange producer.
Quick! Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Boom! It's an Apple. There are thousands of apple varieties around the world.
Trust your instinct. Name it!
Here it is: a Grape. Grapes grow in bunches of up to a hundred or more.
Don't overthink it. Which fruit or vegetable is this?
You got it, it's a Carrot. The first cultivated carrots were purple, not orange.
This one is a classic. Which fruit or vegetable?
Spot on! It's a Broccoli. The part we eat is actually a cluster of flower buds.
Last easy one! Which fruit or vegetable is this?
The answer is a Tomato. Botanically, the tomato is a fruit.
Medium round! Things get trickier. Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Yes! It's a Kiwi. It is named after the kiwi bird of New Zealand.
Look closely at the details. Which fruit or vegetable?
That's a Pomegranate. A single pomegranate can hold hundreds of seeds.
Ten seconds on the clock. Name this fruit or vegetable!
It's an Avocado. Avocados ripen only after they are picked.
This one fools a lot of people. Which fruit or vegetable is it?
Correct answer: a Mango. Mango is the national fruit of India.
Can you get this one right? Which fruit or vegetable?
Of course, it's an Artichoke. The part we eat is a flower bud before it blooms.
Think carefully. What fruit or vegetable is this?
Boom! It's an Eggplant. Some early varieties were white and egg-shaped, which gave it its name.
Here's a tricky one. Name it!
Here it is: a Coconut. A coconut can float across oceans and still sprout.
Got it already? Which fruit or vegetable is this?
You got it, it's a Fig. Figs are actually inside-out flowers.
Keep that streak going! Which fruit or vegetable?
Spot on! It's a Cauliflower. Cauliflower also comes in orange, purple and green.
Last medium question! Which fruit or vegetable is this?
The answer is a Raspberry. Each raspberry is made of many tiny fruits joined together.
Hard round! Only the experts from here. Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Yes! It's a Dragon fruit. It grows on a climbing cactus.
Not so easy now. Which fruit or vegetable?
That's a Lychee. Its bumpy red skin hides sweet white flesh.
Here's one for the experts. Name this fruit or vegetable!
It's a Passion fruit. Its wrinkly skin means it's ripe.
Take your time... but not too much. Which fruit or vegetable?
Correct answer: an Okra. Okra is sometimes called lady's finger.
This one is a real head-scratcher. Which fruit or vegetable is it?
Of course, it's a Starfruit. Cut it into slices and you get perfect stars.
Big brain time! What fruit or vegetable is this?
Boom! It's a Kohlrabi. Its name means cabbage turnip in German.
Lock in your answer! Which fruit or vegetable?
Here it is: a Persimmon. It is the national fruit of Japan.
Few people get this one. Do you?
You got it, it's a Romanesco. Its spirals form a natural fractal pattern.
Are you still with me? Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Spot on! It's a Brussels sprout. They grow along a tall thick stalk.
Last hard one! Which fruit or vegetable?
The answer is a Physalis. Each berry grows inside a papery husk.
Genius round! Only true masters get these. Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Yes! It's a Rambutan. Its name comes from the Malay word for hair.
Seriously tough now. Name this fruit or vegetable!
That's a Durian. Known as the king of fruits, it's famous for its powerful smell.
If you know this one, you're a legend. Which fruit or vegetable?
It's a Mangosteen. Often called the queen of fruits.
Deep cut! Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Correct answer: a Kiwano. Also called horned melon, its flesh is green and jelly-like.
Here's a rare one. What is it?
Of course, it's a Salak. Its scaly skin gives it the name snake fruit.
No hints this time. Which fruit or vegetable?
Boom! It's a Jackfruit. It is the largest tree fruit in the world.
Almost there! Which fruit or vegetable is this?
Here it is: a Cherimoya. Mark Twain called it the most delicious fruit known to men.
Only a handful of people will get this. Which fruit or vegetable?
You got it, it's a Buddha's hand. This citrus fruit is split into finger-like sections.
Second to last! Name this fruit or vegetable!
Spot on! It's a Jabuticaba. Its fruits grow directly on the tree trunk.
Final question! Make it count. Which fruit or vegetable is this?
The answer is a Feijoa. Also called pineapple guava, it's very popular in New Zealand.
That's the last one! How many did you recognise? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
